Join to apply for the Officer, Logistics_FR role at International Medical Corps

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE
Le/la responsable de la logistique fournit des services et un soutien logistiques, conformément aux politiques et procédures d'International Medical Corps ainsi qu'aux réglementations des donateurs et du pays hôte. Le/la responsable de la logistique soutient les activités logistiques au niveau du bureau, y compris l'entretien des bâtiments et les achats associés, la gestion des stocks du bureau, la gestion de la flotte et, si nécessaire, les actifs et le support informatique.
Pour mener à bien ce travail, une personne doit être capable de remplir chaque fonction essentielle avec ou sans aménagements raisonnables.
PRINCIPALES TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS
Gestion du bureau

  • Point focal pour toutes les activités logistiques quotidiennes du bureau et leur suivi .
  • Soutenir le lancement des demandes d'achat et la collecte des offres pour les achats liés au fonctionnement du bureau (entretien, approvisionnement en carburant, nettoyage, fournitures de bureau, etc.). S'assurer que tous les contrats/commandes sont correctement suivis et renouvelés en temps opportun, si nécessaire, auprès du service des achats.
  • Responsable des stocks de fournitures de bureau et des rapports y afférents.
  • Assurer la liaison avec le propriétaire de l'installation pour tout entretien et amélioration de l'espace.
  • Veiller à ce que le bureau soit correctement entretenu.
  • S'assurer que le bureau dispose des équipements de sécurité requis, en étroite collaboration avec le-la responsable de la sûreté et de la sécurité.
Gestion de la flotte
  • Aide à compiler les emplois du temps fournis par tous les services sur une base hebdomadaire
  • Planifier les déplacements hebdomadaires en conséquence et assigner les plannings aux conducteur(trice)s en conséquence.
  • Gère de près les déplacements quotidiens et assure le ravitaillement en carburant en temps opportun des véhicules et des générateurs.
  • Prendre en charge l'orientation des conducteur(trice)s , les briefings sur la sûreté et la sécurité.
Informations et technologies
  • Fournit un soutien au service informatique, selon les besoins, dans :
  • La création de compte pour les nouveaux utilisateurs
  • Le dépannage de base
Connecter des appareils
  • Rapports logistiques
  • Aider à préparer les rapports logistiques comme demandé par le/la directeur(trice)
Gestion des actifs
Le/la responsable de la logistique pourrait être amené(e) à servir de point focal des actifs avec les responsabilités ci-dessous.
  • Mettre en œuvre les politiques et procédures de gestion des actifs d’IMC.
  • Responsable de la gestion des actifs sur le site de terrain respectif sur la base des procédures de gestion des actifs d’IMC.
  • Veiller à ce que chaque actif et article attrayant soit enregistré, émis avec un identifiant d'actif unique d’IMC, attribué au dépositaire et suivi conformément aux procédures de gestion des actifs.
  • Documente l’ensemble des transactions ou changements de statut liés aux actifs.
  • Fournir un soutien à la direction dans les tâches liées aux actifs.
  • Soutenir la direction dans le rapprochement mensuel, sur la base des informations générées par les rapports Cognos automatisés indiquant que tous les actifs achetés ont été enregistrés dans la liste des actifs et que les informations financières sont consignées avec précision par les documents de sauvegarde des bons correspondants.
  • S'assurer que tous les actifs/éléments attrayants sous sa responsabilité sont confiés au dépositaire qui est un(e) employé(e) actif(ve).
  • Responsable du transfert documenté vers/depuis le dépositaire, en coordination avec les services concernés (par exemple, les RH pour le personnel nouvellement embauché/les licenciements).
  • Contrôler régulièrement l'exactitude des informations de la liste des actifs, de leur statut et du dépositaire.
  • Signaler à l'équipe de direction tout élément identifié comme manquant/perdu à des fins d’enquête (lorsque les raisons ne sont pas connues).
  • Initier les demandes de maintenance des actifs, le cas échéant.
  • Introduire une demande d'évaluation et d'élimination des articles inutilisables dès leur signalement.
  • Commencer l'évaluation de l'article nécessitant une réparation et en assurer le suivi jusqu'à la réparation.
  • S'assurer que l'élimination des articles est approuvée et documentée et que la documentation est partagée avec la direction pour communication ultérieure au bureau logistique.
  • Soutenir la direction pour organiser des contrôles ponctuels et un inventaire complet.
  • Avant de soumettre la demande d'assurance, examiner la liste des articles y afférents et s'assurer que les demandes sont accompagnées de toutes les pièces justificatives requises.
  • Agir au nom du service des actifs lorsque cela est demandé.
  • Effectue d'autres activités liées à la gestion des actifs comme indiqué. Prévention de la fraude
  • S'engage à prévenir, détecter, signaler et réduire les risques de fraude, conformément aux politiques et procédures d’IMC, aux règles des donateurs et aux lois et réglementations locales.
  • Maintient des systèmes de classement précis, avec des enregistrements documentés et vérifiables des transactions d'approvisionnement et des rapports/suivi.
Effectuer les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées. Les fonctions et responsabilités énumérées dans le présent document sont représentatives de la nature et du volume du travail assigné et ne sont pas nécessairement exhaustives.
Qualifications Minimales
  • Généralement, un diplôme de baccalauréat en logistique, chaîne logistique, gestion des transports. Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinentes peut être acceptée le cas échéant.
  • Généralement, plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la logistique.
  • Bonnes compétences relationnelles et esprit d'équipe.
  • Engagement et compréhension des objectifs, valeurs et principes d'IMC.
  • Connaissance de MS Office, y compris MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook.
  • Capacité à bien s’intégrer et travailler au sein d’équipes multiethniques et multiculturelles.
  • Capacité à travailler dans des conditions difficiles, souvent dans des zones reculées, souhaitable.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral
  • Diplômes ou cours de formation pertinents.
Job Summary
The Officer, Logistics delivers Logistics services and support in accordance with International Medical Corps policies and procedures, donor and host country regulations. The Logistics Officer supports logistics activities at office level, including building maintenance and related procurements, managing office stocks, fleet management and where required
Assets and IT support.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function with or without reasonable accommodation.
Main Tasks And Responsibilities
Office management
  • Focal Point for all the daily office logistics activities and follow up
  • Support initiation of PR and offer collection for procurements related to office operation (maintenance, fuel supply, cleaning, office supplies, etc.). Ensuring that all contracts/orders are adequately tracked and timely renewed when required with the procurement department.
  • Responsible for office supplies stocks and reports
  • Liaise with facility owner for any maintenance and space improvement.
  • Ensure the office is appropriately maintained.
  • Ensure office has required safety equipment, in close collaboration with the safety and security manager.
Fleet Management
  • Assists in compiling \schedules provided by all departments on weekly basis
  • Plan weekly movements accordingly and assign planning to drivers accordingly.
  • Manages closely daily trips and ensures timely refueling of vehicles and generators.
  • Support drivers’ orientation, safety and security briefing
Information and Technologies
  • Provides support to IT department as required, in:
  • Setting up account for new users
  • Basic troubleshooting
Connecting devices
  • Logistics reports
  • Assist in preparing logistics reports as tasked by manager
Asset Management
Logistics Officer might be required to act as Asset Focal Point with below responsibilities
  • Implement IMC Asset Management policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for the management of the assets in the respective field site based on the IMC Asset Management procedures.
  • Responsible for ensuring that every Asset and Attractive Item is logged, issued with unique IMC asset ID, assigned to Custodian and tracked in line with Assets Management procedures.
  • Documents all assets related transactions or status change.
  • Provide support to management in asset related duties.
  • Support management in the monthly reconciliation, based on information generated through automated Cognos Reports that all purchased Assets have been logged into the Asset List and financial information is accurately recorded per corresponding voucher backup documents.
  • Ensure that all Assets/Attractive Items under their responsibility are assigned to Custodian which is an active employee.
  • Responsible for documented handover to/from Custodian, in coordination with relevant departments (i.e. HR for newly hired staff/termination).
  • Provide input in the accuracy of Asset List information, status and Custodian regularly.
  • Report to management team any items identified as missing/lost, for investigation (when reasons are not known).
  • Initiate requests for asset maintenance where required.
  • Initiate request for appraisal and disposal of unusable items whenever reported.
  • Initiate appraisal of item requiring repair and follow up until item is fixed.
  • Ensure item disposals are approved and documented, documentation shared with management for onwards communication to the Logistics Desk.
  • Support management to organize spot checks and full inventory.
  • Review list of items for insurance claim prior to claim submission and ensure claims have all required backup documentation.
  • Act on behalf of the Asset department when tasked.
  • Performs other activities related to asset management as indicated. Fraud prevention
  • Committed to fraud prevention, detection, reporting and fraud risk reduction as per IMC policies and procedures, donor rules and local laws and regulations.
  • Maintains accurate filing systems, with documented and auditable records of procurement transactions and reports/tracker.
Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed in this document are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily all inclusive.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Typically, a bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, transport management. An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.
  • Typically, 3+ years of experience in Logistics
  • Good interpersonal and team skills
  • Commitment to and understanding of IMC’s aims, values and principles
  • Knowledge of MS Office including MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Ability to integrate and work well within multi-ethnic and multicultural teams.
  • Ability to work in harsh conditions, often in remote areas, Desirable
  • Fluency in written and spoken English
  • Relevant qualifications or training courses.

Sobre Nós:

O prazer é todo nosso ; )

Cada hotel tem uma característica especial. Muitas vezes, o grande desafio é encontrar qual e desenvolver o seu potencial. Por isso, a Trul é a primeira operadora multimarcas de Minas Gerais a aplicar o conceito de Customização Hoteleira. O que, em outras palavras, significa entender o que um hotel tem de melhor para, assim, desenvolver marcas e experiências únicas para o hóspede.

A Trul é detalhista e completa: cuida da implantação à operação hoteleira. Acompanha cada detalhe para garantir a gestão eficiente e necessária para atrair clientes e, claro, criar motivos para que eles voltem sempre. =)

Descrição:

Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de precificação e receitas dos hotéis, acompanhando o comportamento do mercado, concorrentes e perfil dos hóspedes, visando gerar lucro para os empreendimentos.

Atividades:

  • Analisar e monitorar o mercado e os concorrentes, usando as informações do set competitivo, acompanhando hábitos de compra dos hóspedes em relação ao empreendimento, para determinar as melhores estratégias de precificação;
  • Acompanhar as tendências e avanços tecnológicos do setor através da pesquisa de mercado, análise dos concorrentes e networking, visando a otimização dos processos e melhoria na receita.
  • Estabelecer, em parceria com o departamento comercial, estratégias para o fechamento de vendas do empreendimento, objetivando alcançar os melhores resultados e garantir a satisfação dos hóspedes.
  • Realizar a previsão das receitas futuras do empreendimento com base no histórico de vendas, levando em consideração o volume de faturamento do hotel, visando planejar com antecedência as estratégias de vendas, marketing e operação, bem como identificar oportunidades de crescimento, minimizar riscos financeiros e apoiar na tomada de decisão.
  • Elaborar indicadores do departamento, para acompanhar e monitorar o desempenho das estratégias de precificação e gestão de receitas do empreendimento.
  • Conduzir o processo de onboarding da área, garantindo que os novos colaboradores recebam toda a orientação necessária para desempenhar suas funções corretamente;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com os demais setores da empresa, buscando a integração e colaboração entre as áreas;
  • Participar da implantação de novos hotéis na central de reservas, colaborando no desenvolvimento de processos e procedimentos;
  • Participar de reuniões com a diretoria para apresentar os indicadores do departamento e contribuir na elaboração de estratégias.

Para a vaga consideramos necessário:

  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Experiência em RM;
  • Atuação na área hoteleira;
  • Experiência em PMS: Opera Cloud, Totvs (Vhf, Thex).

Para a vaga consideramos desejável:

  • Graduação em gestão hoteleira/turismo ou afins;

Para a vaga consideramos diferencial:

title: Lead Turbine Design Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

The turbine lead Engineer should be the technical person responsible for turbine mechanical design coordination in a project execution . He will be responsible to give ll all the need technical support not only to the engineering team but also to the other cross functional areas.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Be the technical person in charge of hydro turbine mechanical design on a new or refurbishment project, supported by Principal/Consulting Engineers.
  • Analyze technical information from Work Packages (Technical Specifications, Division of Work) and participate in identifying the risks and opportunities of the project on technical matters.
  • Plan and follow project engineering basic design phase and coordinate with Hydraulic design team (hydraulic test lab) and Special Calculation team.
  • Perform designs and calculations of turbine components and validate critical ones with Principal/Consulting Engineers.
  • Direct and manage design reviews, perform design review actions follow-up.
  • Provide technical support to the customer in coordination with the project System Integrator.
  • Prepare information for the execution of technical drawings and supervise and validate the draftsman work.
  • Optimize designs with Supply Chain, Site Installation to get the lowest installed equipment costs.
  • Write reports and engineering documents, including test procedures, engineering calculation notes, operation and maintenance manuals.
  • Occasionally conduct site visits to assess the existing turbine and participate to signature tests on the unit before disassembly at site.
  • Provide technical support to Supply Chain and to Site Installation team (erection and commissioning) of sub-assemblies / components under your responsibility.
  • Follow up the performance testing of the prototype turbine on site.
  • Develop tools and design guides for turbine engineering.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering including a minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in mechanical design.
  • Experience with NX, AutoCad and/or SolidWorks .
  • Demonstrate technical leadership.
  • Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively.
  • Must be willing to comply with pre-employment screening, including but not limited, reference verification and background check.
  • Availability for occasional travel, in Brazil, Canada and USA.
  • Willingness to develop in-depth knowledge of hydro technical discipline using prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English (French is a plus).
  • Interact fluidly with colleagues in our other facilities across and/or outside Brazil, and who are generally unable to communicate in Portuguese and whose language at work is predominantly English.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams.
  • Ability to coordinate several mandates simultaneously.
  • Effective problem identification and solution skills.
  • Proven analytical and organizational ability.

  • Atuar como backup de colegas ausentes;
  • Cumprir metas de qualidade;
  • Executar manutenção conforme Ordens de Serviço;
  • Executar podas programadas e emergenciais em redes de baixa e média tensão;
  • Executar Ordens de Serviço de emergência despachadas pelo Centro de Controle;
  • Auxiliar em manobras de alimentadores em redes de média tensão;
  • Realizar inspeções para identificar causas de defeitos e corrigi-las;
  • Manter comunicação clara com o CCBT/MT durante intervenções;
  • Esgotar opções antes de solicitar recursos adicionais ou cancelar atividades;
  • Realizar medições de tensão e balanceamento de carga sob demanda.

O que esperamos de você:

1. Ensino Fundamental completo (8ª série, 9º ano). Desejável Ensino Médio completo.

2. Curso de Eletricista de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica, mínimo de 240 horas.

Diferencial: Curso de formação em eletrotécnica.

3. Curso de eletricista de rede de distribuição desenergizada (32h), obrigatório apenas para quem fez o curso de 240h antes de 01/01/2022.

Requisitos para o processo SER-HSEQ-HeS-20-0228-EDBR incluem cursos de NR-10 (40h), NR-10 SEP (40h), trabalho em altura (16h), entre outros requisitos adicionais como habilitação de acesso a áreas de risco.

Desejável experiência na área de distribuição, com conhecimento em atendimento emergencial, manutenção preventiva em MT/BT.

Por que se juntar a nós?

Nossos benefícios incluem:

  • Auxílio academia, creche, funeral, entre outros;
  • Programas de qualidade de vida, planos de saúde e odontológico, previdência privada, seguro de vida, vale alimentação/refeição, entre outros;

Local de trabalho: São Gonçalo - RJ

Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Processo de Seleção

title: Analista Contábil Tributário
description:
Olá somos a Gralha Azul Portas, Madeiras e ACM Premium Door, nascemos em 1991 e desde 2020 estamos em pleno crescimento e evolução. Somos uma empresa dinâmica, que adora mudanças e promove melhorias em nossos processos. Aqui o Cliente é a prioridade número um e fazemos nosso melhor por ele. Se você é dinâmico, gosta de desafios novos e adora mudanças, você vai se identificar com nossa cultura!

Para esse cargo precisamos que:

Assegure o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e contábeis da empresa, garantindo a conformidade com as leis e regulamentos tributários, bem como otimizando a carga tributária dentro dos limites legais.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apuração e Contabilização de Impostos: realizar a apuração e contabilização dos impostos diretos e indiretos, como ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ORPJ e CSLL, de acordo com as normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes.
  2. Elaboração de obrigações acessórias: preparar e entregar as obrigações acessórias exigidas pelos órgãos governamentais, SPED Fiscal, EFD contribuições, DCTF, DIRF, entre outras, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  3. Análise de Legislação: Manter-se atualizado sobre as alterações na legislação tributária e avaliar seu impacto nas operações da empresa, propondo ajustes necessários para garantir a conformidade e minimizar riscos fiscais.
  4. Planejamento tributário: colaborar no desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de planejamento tributário, visando otimizar a carga tributária da empresa de forma legal e ética.
  5. Atendimento a fiscalizações: prestar suporte durante fiscalizações tributárias, fornecendo informações e documentos solicitados pelos auditores e auxiliando na resolução de eventuais pendências.
  6. Análise de Contratos e Operações: analisar contratos e operações da empresa para identificar possíveis impactos tributários e propor soluções que minimizem riscos e maximizem benefícios fiscais.
  7. Gestão de Certidões e parcelamentos: gerenciar a obtenção e renovação de certidões negativas de débitos e parcelamentos fiscais, garantindo a regularidade fiscal da empresa.

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em contabilidade e tributação, preferencialmente em empresas ou escritórios de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação tributária e normas contábeis.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de ERP e ferramentas de gestão fiscal.
  • Habilidade analítica e capacidade de resolver problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

title: Operador(a) de Logística
description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência em recebimento, conferência, separação e movimentação de mercadorias.
  • Experiência no sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.
  • Desejável habilidade na administração de prioridades.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado, prática e permanente respeito aos procedimentos, normas e regras da empresa.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.
  • Orientação para a satisfação do cliente.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Operador(a) de Logística:

  • RECEPÇÃO DE MERCADORIAS:
    • Realiza a recepção quantitativa e qualitativa das mercadorias comercializadas e não comercializadas (equipamentos, materiais de escritório, etc), verificando e identificando o estado geral, fornecedor, metragem, referência, tonalidade, prazo de validade, etc.
    • Prepara o espaço físico e equipamentos necessários para a correta recepção, evitando a perda de produtividade na conferência.
    • Anota sobre o relatório de conferência tudo o que for relativo às mercadorias recebidas (quantidades, estado aparente, validades, etc), assegurando qualidade e prevenindo perdas.
    • Armazena as mercadorias no endereço de depósito correto, através da leitura da ficha da recepção buscando agilizar as futuras montagens dos pedidos de retira ou de entrega.
    • Etiqueta os produtos com código de barra ausente ou defeituoso e inserir as etiquetas de segurança nos produtos sensíveis a furtos, assegurando que as mercadorias entregues ao comércio estejam disponíveis para venda.
    • Separa as mercadorias seguindo a tipologia dos fluxos quanto a mercadorias de loja ou do depósito.
    • Libera as mercadorias para a armazenagem na Loja ou no Depósito, contatando a equipe de Reposição ou a de Armazenamento para efetuar a armazenagem (Cautela).
    • Realiza ações anti-demarcas através da checagem qualitativa e quantitativa rigorosa sobre as mercadorias recepcionadas, através de um bom fluxo de veículos no pátio da Recepção de Mercadorias e do correto manuseio dos equipamentos de movimentação (paleteiras, "gaiolas", etc).
    • Mantém organizado os equipamentos, ferramentas de trabalho e EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual).
    • Realiza o empilhamento seguro dos paletes evitando prejuízos à bens e pessoas.
    • Mantém a área de recepção limpa e organizada ajudando a combater a demarca e prevenindo acidentes no trabalho.
    • Recebe as demarcas validadas pelo Comércio realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e colocando o produto demarcado no local de despejo.
    • Recebe as devoluções aos fornecedores, validadas pelo Comércio, realizando as conferências quali-quantitativas e agendando a coleta.
    • Recebe as remessas para Assistência Técnica, realizando a conferência qualitativa e quantitativa e agendando a coleta.
  • RETIRADA E ENTREGA EM DOMICÍLIO:
    • Efetua a separação do RSS (reserva sobre estoque), identificando os produtos e informando a separação para o setor comercial.
    • Realiza o endereçamento das mercadorias fazendo a reserva física de espaço e inventário rotativo com base na listagem dos produtos de RSS.
    • Efetua a entrega das mercadorias ao cliente, de forma ágil e cordial, colocando-as no veículo do cliente.
    • Separa e confere as mercadorias verificando todos os itens descritos no pedido emitido, disponibilizando-as para entrega a clientes no setor de retirada de mercadorias ou para transportadora (entrega em domicilio).
  • REPOSIÇÃO:
    • Repõe os produtos na loja de forma adequada.
  • GESTÃO DO ESTOQUE:
    • Armazena e garante a qualidade e a confiabilidade dos estoques.
    • Verifica diariamente os pedidos gerados pela área comercial, analisa a consistência de dados necessários no pedido (endereços, telefones, data entrega, referência, disponibilidade, etc), organizando a separação cronológica dos pedidos e liberando-os para faturamento.
    • Efetua atendimento telefônico informando os clientes sobre prazos de entrega.
    • Informa o Supervisor de Logística sobre eventuais problemas que envolvem a equipe de separação, operação e produtos.
    • Auxilia o Supervisor de Logística para o bom andamento dos endereçamentos do depósito (set-up, inventários rotativos, etc).
    • Efetua o tratamento diário dos pedidos cancelados de RSS.
    • Efetua o registro referente a demarcas de mercadorias apontadas na separação de mercadorias.
    • Tem bom relacionamento e atua como elo de contato com a transportadora terceirizada.
    • Juntamente com a equipe de SAC realiza o trabalho preventivo de possíveis problemas com mercadorias.
    • Informa ao Supervisor de Logística e/ou ao Gerente de Logística sobre eventuais ocorrências de problemas com mercadorias.
    • É referência no atendimento do Balcão de Retirada de Mercadorias.
    • É responsável pelos seus equipamentos de trabalho.
    • Respeita as normas de segurança.

1. Diagnóstico e reparo de veículos: Você será responsável por diagnosticar problemas mecânicos em veículos, determinar as causas raiz e executar reparos eficientes e precisos.
2. Manutenção preventiva: Você deve ser capaz de realizar manutenção preventiva em veículos para garantir seu bom funcionamento e prolongar a vida útil.
3. Trabalho em equipe: Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outros mecânicos e membros da equipe para garantir que nossos veículos sejam mantidos em excelente condição.

EXPERIENCIA NA FUNÇÃO, CNH B, COMPROMETIMENTO E RESPONSABILIDADE.

Job Description

Denodo is looking for a creative, focused, well-organized, and highly-motivated individual to drive their GSI Partner and Channel Sales. This individual will win, maintain, and expand relationships with channel, reseller, and systems integrator / consulting partners and is responsible for achieving sales, profitability, and partner recruitment objectives.

The role carries an Indirect / Influenced Sales quota and requires working closely with marketing to drive joint demand-generation and with Direct Sales colleagues in the field to accelerate opportunities through partners.

Operating at a strategic level, the candidate will help create new programs and incentives to grow partner ecosystem for sales and services that meet the needs of both partners and customers, so this position is not routine.

Job Responsibilities & Duties

Recruitment, Enablement, Development

  • Proactively recruits new qualifying partners
  • Establishes productive, professional relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts.
  • Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs, gaps and requirements to be successful on an ongoing basis.
  • Develop training materials, create presentations for resellers. Coordinate with other company teams to deliver adequate partner training for business and technical skills
  • Leads solution development efforts that best address end-user needs, while coordinating the involvement of all necessary company and partner personnel.

Partner Sales Planning and Execution

  • Proactively leads a joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship.
  • Coordinates the involvement of company personnel, including direct sales, marketing, support, services, and management resources, in order to meet partner performance objectives and partners’ expectations.
  • Meets assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned territory and partner accounts.
  • Depending on the territory may achieve revenue goals working in several sales models:
  • Direct territories: Generate opportunities through partners and connect with Denodo direct sales teams in those territories to consummate sale
  • Indirect-only territories: Sells through partner organizations to end users in coordination with partner sales resources.
  • VARs: Enable partner organizations to handle unassisted sales to end users
  • Build a strong partner pipeline through co-marketing programs, account and field mapping of company and partner sellers
  • Provide regular governance, reporting, and management of indirect and joint/co-selling activities

General Partner Management

  • Manages potential channel conflict with other firm sales channels by fostering excellent communication internally and externally, and through strict adherence to channel rules of engagement.
  • Ensures partner compliance with partner agreements.
  • Drives adoption of company programs among assigned partners
  • Monitors performance of partners and coaches them to higher levels of success.
  • Assist the overall business development team in developing good PRM systems, efficient partner workflows, company and partner performance reporting, partner marketing and support activities to enhance the partner program.

Desired Skills & Experience

  • BS/BA or higher degree
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in a similar role with a strong focus on indirect sales and channel development for a software company.
  • Track record of results-oriented sales and partner management that sets and achieves metrics for partner recruiting, enablement, opportunity generation, revenue.
  • Excellent knowledge and experience of the workings of reseller, systems integrator and consulting ecosystem. Past relationships and network is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to interact with technical and business counterparts both within and outside the company.
  • Professional sales training would be an advantage but not essential.
  • Willingness to travel around 25-50%.
  • Be a team worker with a positive attitude.
  • Nice to have experience in leveraging Employee Advocacy and Social Media to network with industry peers, share thought leadership content, and enhance brand visibility to support sales engagement and relationship building.

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
The position involves supporting all reservoir engineering activities, including oil and gas reserve estimation, production forecasting, reservoir simulation, and production optimization, while also demonstrating an understanding of geoscience concepts, drilling, completions, and production operations.

• Expert in integrated reservoir simulation studies, including data analysis and integration, model construction, history matching, calibration and predictions.

• Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both NPV and hydrocarbon recovery.

• Competent in the analysis of capillary pressure, relative permeability and PVT data.

• Competent in compositional reservoir modeling.

• Participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.

• Evaluates and initiates exploitation opportunities, including new drilling and work-overs to maximize reserves recovery and booking, and overall play economics.

• Prepare data and perform PTA interpretation and modeling.

• Formulate the strategies for reservoir development, data acquisition, field surveillance and monitor masterplans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.

• Extensive working knowledge of standard vendor applications for pre and post-processing of simulation data and Assisted History Matching software and workflows.

• Is familiar with field production activities to effectively implement reservoir management aspects during the field production phase, including liaison with regulatory agencies.

• Develop Life of Field production profiles and maintain auditable booked reserves estimates and reserves reports

• Coordinate and integrate data, simulation and studies between Artificial lift, production, and dynamic modeling to support the other areas.

• Work with the Production Engineer/Technologist to optimize well potentials.

• Write concise reports for all studies and maintain comprehensive, accessible and up-to-date records of input and interpreted data.

• Coordinates with the business development on acquisition and divestiture projects. Supports the reservoir engineering evaluation component of company acquisition


Education

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Petroleum Engineering.

• Long relevant experience may compensate for formal education

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience with reservoir engineering within the oil and gas industry.

• Reservoir engineering, reservoir management and reservoir simulation skills are essential.

• Proven track record in performing reservoir modeling and field development studies.

• Pressure transient analysis (PTA) interpretation experience will be a plus.
Knowledge

• High proficiency in any reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or T-Nav preferred)

• Proficiency in any production software like Pipesim and/or Prosper.

• Experience with any pressure transient analysis software like Kappa or Pansystem.

description:
As Workplace Experience Partner ll you will keep the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena rolling and cultivate a space where all Rioters can thrive. You will be responsible for assisting the Americas Region Workplace Experience Manager in all aspects of local operations management and program management within the scope of workplace experience as well as being the primary point of contact for the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the overall inner-workings of the Riot office and arena. Partner with stakeholders such as local Riot leadership, building management, WE team, and Physical Security to develop and enact programs that maximize workplace effectiveness. Ensure the established budget is maintained and work to hold vendors accountable within budgetary constraints.
  • Manage local vendor and/or supplier relationships to ensure WE contractors perform day-to-day responsibilities and continue to meet Riot standards. Coordinate with on-site physical security as needed.
  • Monitor for and oversee maintenance and repairs, closely aligning with local and WE leadership. Monitor and improve office and arena environments to adhere to WE standards.
  • Partner with local leadership to drive effective Workplace Experience programs and provide insight on workplace needs.
  • Welcome visitors and out-of-town Rioters to the office. Allocate and log visitor passes to the office and help out-of-town Rioters with temporary badge access. Support creation of any workplace experience-related processes for the eSports arena.
  • Support space planning and workplace moves by collaborating with Rioters to understand their needs and executing necessary changes. Ensure the workspace is optimized to enable teams to operate effectively and deliver high value to our players.
  • Perform environmental health and safety (EHS) compliance activities and maintain and optimize office procedure documentation.
  • Support local office events and large-scale initiatives, including esports tournaments and cultural celebrations that reflect Brazilian holidays and traditions. Responsibilities include event planning, communications, vendor coordination, and on-site support to drive employee engagement and a strong sense of belonging.
  • Support regional operations, including recruiting coordination, employer branding and marketing initiatives, and managing travel logistics for local Rioters. This includes handling travel arrangements and collaborating with travel agencies to ensure smooth and cost-effective travel experiences.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience of providing facilities or maintenance service in a busy organization.
  • Experience managing contractors and suppliers, including monitoring service standards and ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures. Strong negotiation skills are essential for vendor management and contract discussions.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Brazilian labor law (CLT), particularly in adapting workplace practices to remain compliant.
  • Events management expertise with the ability to deliver high-quality, compliant experiences.
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to take initiative, function in a fast-paced working environment, with immediate and changing deadlines.
  • Ability to prioritize workload, with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and time management are a must.
  • Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to interact comfortably and effectively with managers and employees at all levels within our company.
  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to operate independently and proactively with little or no supervision.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

We offer medical, dental, and vision plans that cover you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children. Life insurance, parental leave, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage are also available. Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations. Balance between work and personal life is encouraged with open paid time off, and a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your personal relationship with games.

Because together we are better

It's our policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and members of Riot Games. We know that fresh and varied perspectives will make us better at what we do, so however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, we're excited to hear from you. Don't be discouraged if you feel you don't fully meet every single one of the requirements for a particular role, there's always room for growth at. Riot. If this role excites you and aligns with your passion for entertainment and live production, we’re eager to hear from you.

Hard Skills
  • Advanced proficiency in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads)

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced Sales Manager to join our team in Brazil, taking over an established role with responsibility for growing and maintaining our business in the region. You’ll work closely with regional leadership to develop and execute sales strategies, secure new projects, and deliver on revenue goals.

You will engage directly with Tier 1 network providers, broadcast operators, telcos, and content owners to deliver complex solutions for large-scale projects across live professional video delivery and primary distribution. The role includes international travel and calls for a consultative approach to ensure our solutions meet customers’ needs from concept to delivery.

Candidate profile
You’re a commercially driven sales professional with strong market knowledge and a proven track record of senior-level engagements. You’re comfortable managing the entire sales process, from initial discussions through to successful delivery. You build lasting relationships as a trusted advisor and have a service-minded approach to understanding your customers’ needs.

Key qualifications

  • 6+ years of business development or sales executive experience with proven results
  • Strong industry network and established relationships with key stakeholders
  • Enterprise sales experience in video compression, contribution, live production, OTT, or signal transport
  • Solid understanding of live video workflows for media and broadcast, including live linear channels, live event contribution, and OTT delivery
  • Confident in engaging with C-level clients in technical and commercial discussions
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Fluent in English, Portuguese and Spanish

Main responsibilities

  • Meet or exceed annual revenue targets aligned with global objectives
  • Work with the regional head to define and execute sales strategy
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline
  • Identify and pursue new clients and opportunities, mapping organisations and key influencers
  • Develop trusted-advisor relationships with key customers and partners
  • Collaborate with Technical Sales to deliver tailored materials and proposals
  • Prepare sales reports and accurate revenue forecasts, highlighting areas for improvement
  • Work cross-functionally to address customer needs, from product development to portal enhancements
  • Represent Appear at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings
  • Be available to travel as needed

Working at Appear
At Appear, you will enjoy an informal, inclusive, and collaborative environment with the energy of a growth-oriented company, where we value close collaboration with our customers and partners and offer the opportunity to work with world-class, cutting-edge technology. Be part of a growing global company and experience cross-cultural collaboration in a diverse and dynamic work environment, with over 30 different nationalities at our office today!

Application deadline: August 4th

Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, Appear is a leader in live production technology, specialising in high-capacity, sustainable solutions for media processing and content delivery. Our portfolio is designed to support the most complex scenarios of live event contribution, adapting seamlessly to the ever-evolving dynamics of the media, entertainment, and sports industries.

Our extensive client base, including world-leading content creators like NBCUniversal, Warner Bros. Discovery, Formula 1, NHL, and Riot Games, rely on our solutions to deliver the highest profile live media with utmost integrity and efficiency. This trust underscores our position at the pinnacle of live production technology, where our commitment to excellence and innovation meets the critical demands of the most prestigious live events worldwide.

Founded in 2004, Appear has established itself as a leader in the industry. Thanks to our world-renowned team of experts and their relentless emphasis on modularity and functional versatility, we are at the forefront of innovation in live production technology.

We actively participate with key industry bodies and technology partners to drive the advancement of standardisation and foster continuous innovation. Our excellence is internationally recognised through numerous accolades, including the prestigious NAB Excellence in Sustainability Award and TVBEurope’s Best in Market, celebrating our achievements in sustainability and technological leadership.

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer – Risk & Compliance Technology (Brazil)
description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A technology-driven risk and compliance platform that empowers businesses to manage third-party insurance requirements with confidence. By combining deep insurance expertise with modern AI tools, they deliver real-time insights, reduce risk exposure, and streamline operations. Through their newest platform, they are redefining certificate of insurance tracking with automation and intelligent workflows that simplify complex compliance processes and support business growth.


Job Summary

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to help build scalable AI-powered systems using Large Language Models (LLMs) for document understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and intelligent classification tasks. This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives on shipping real-world AI applications, collaborating cross-functionally with engineering and product teams, and applying state-of-the-art NLP techniques to practical use cases. You’ll play a key part in designing and optimizing LLM pipelines that drive smarter workflows, improve automation, and enhance the customer experience.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement systems that integrate LLMs into production environments (e.g., summarization, classification, RAG pipelines).

  • Fine-tune or adapt foundation models to suit domain-specific use cases.

  • Build and maintain prompt-based and retrieval-augmented workflows to improve accuracy and context.

  • Evaluate and benchmark LLM performance on custom tasks and datasets.

  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams to build end-user features powered by AI.

  • Monitor and optimize inference performance, latency, and cost.

  • Stay current with the latest in NLP research, tooling, and model architectures.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 3+ years in AI/ML engineering, with at least 1 year of hands-on work with LLMs.

  • Proficiency in Python and experience integrating models via APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain).

  • Understanding of embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval techniques.

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, model evaluation, and fine-tuning practices.

  • Demonstrated experience contributing to deployed AI-powered products or internal tools.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

title: Technical Purchaser
description:
This position is responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, ensuring adherence to Supply Chain procedures and alignment with project-specific requirements. The role involves managing the full procurement cycle — from requisition to delivery — while working closely with internal departments, suppliers, and logistics to guarantee timely, cost-effective, and compliant operations. It also includes contract negotiation, supplier performance management, and continuous contribution to process improvement and strategic sourcing initiatives.

  • Responsible for the procurement of medium to large equipment packages, in accordance with SC procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with BW Energy’s SC procedures and project-specific Procurement Plans.
  • Manage procurement, expediting, and supply chain control from requisition to onboard delivery.
  • Liaise with freight forwarders and logistics to optimize deliveries and minimize freight/customs costs.
  • Ensure quality and suitability of equipment/spares in coordination with relevant departments.
  • Apply thorough cost control throughout procurement activities.
  • Issue Purchase Orders in IFS and perform material receiving when required.
  • Monitor changes in the supplier market; maintain balanced contact with local and global suppliers.
  • Participate in supplier meetings and contribute to supplier relationship development.
  • Maintain commodity knowledge and oversee the development of the Bidders List.
  • Support implementation and understanding of frame agreements and identify needs for new agreements.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs.
  • Evaluate bids, perform clarifications, and negotiate with suppliers.
  • Analyze TCO / Life Cycle Costs and recommend awards.
  • Coordinate with Legal on contract terms and supplier qualifications.
  • Participate in the negotiation and implementation of strategic contracts (short, long-term or MSAs).
  • Monitor supplier production schedules and ensure delivery capability.
  • Identify and mitigate risks to delivery schedules.
  • Maintain IFS database accuracy; liaise quarterly with requisitioners to validate open requests.
  • Prepare regular Procurement Status Reports (PSR).
  • Ensure compliance with E&P policies, internal controls, and applicable tax regulations.
  • Guarantee the implementation of contracts for oil lifting operations.
  • Contribute to global SC initiatives and bid inputs for new contracts.
  • Support alignment of local SC practices with global best practices.
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned and best practice adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with local content requirements.


Education

  • Education / degree within Purchasing and/or Logistics Administration will be preferred;
  • Long relevant experience may replace educational requirements.


Experience

  • Ideally, 8 years of working experience within purchase, preferably from Supply Chain within the oil & gas or marine related industry;
  • Previous experience with ERP systems.

Knowledge

  • In-depth knowledge of the local supply market for the oil & gas industry and general knowledge to the international oil & gas supplier market;
  • Familiar with the terminology of the oil & gas industry;
  • Good understanding/knowledge of ERP systems;
  • Technical knowledge/understanding of the oil & gas industry is an advantage.
  • Advanced English (oral and written);
  • Understanding and knowledge of the technical, contractual, and commercial issues related to the design and engineering of Floating, Production, Storage, and Offloading vessels is an advantage.

Desde setembro de 2021 temos um programa estruturado para promover a diversidade e um ambiente inclusivo. Temos atuado em governança, engajamento interno e atração e desenvolvimento de talentos com diversidade.

Revimos nossas práticas de recrutamento e seleção com vistas a atrair e promover a diversidade. Estamos ativamente buscando pessoas não só de variadas características, como de diversas origens, formações e lugares de morada.

Nossas pessoas pertencentes a grupos de diversidade recomendam a LCA para pessoas como elas trabalharem –veja aqui um resumo dos resultados da pesquisa. Estamos no começo, temos muito o que aprender e melhorar, e estes primeiros resultados só nos encorajam a seguir em frente.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

title: Analista de Vendas Senior Customer Service - John Crane - São Paulo
description:
John Crane, uma empresa do Smiths Group, é líder global em soluções de controle de fluxo de missão crítica para indústrias de energia e processos que permitem operações eficientes e sustentáveis. Nossos produtos incluem selos e sistemas mecânicos, acoplamentos, rolamentos, sistemas de filtragem e tecnologias de monitoramento digital preditivo.

Temos uma rede global de mais de 200 locais em mais de 50 países e empregamos mais de 6.000 pessoas em todo o mundo. Estabelecemos parcerias com nossos clientes para ajudá-los a manter suas operações seguras, reduzir o tempo de inatividade, melhorar a eficiência e atender aos mais recentes padrões ambientais.

John Crane faz parte do Grupo Smiths. Por mais de 170 anos, a Smiths tem sido pioneira no progresso da engenharia para um futuro melhor. Servimos milhões de pessoas todos os anos, ajudando a criar um mundo mais seguro, mais eficiente, produtivo e mais bem conectado em quatro mercados globais: energia, segurança e defesa, espaço e aeroespacial e industrial em geral. Listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres, a Smiths emprega aproximadamente 16.000 colegas em mais de 50 países.

Descrição da vaga

Apoiar o engenheiro de vendas no atendimento aos clientes, incluindo recebimento de cotações, elaboração de propostas comerciais com precificação e tributos, e suporte em dúvidas sobre prazos, faturamento, logística e demais solicitações.

Processar pedidos de venda no sistema e encaminhá-los para as áreas responsáveis (fábrica ou engenharia), garantindo agilidade na produção dos materiais.

Assegurar a qualidade, precisão e sigilo das informações e serviços sob sua responsabilidade.

Atuar em conformidade com o Código de Ética Empresarial, normas de segurança do trabalho, meio ambiente e padrões de qualidade da empresa.

Manter-se atualizado com inovações do setor, contribuindo com sugestões de melhorias em processos e equipamentos.

Participar da descrição, revisão e cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais da área.

Executar outras atividades relacionadas à função, conforme orientação da liderança.

Qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursandonas áreas de Administração, Contabil ou afins.
  • Inglês técnico básico.
  • Experiência na área comercial de +3 anos.
  • Vivência na área fiscal.

Informações adicionais

Com colegas espalhados por todo o mundo, estamos orgulhosos da nossa diversidade. Para promover a inclusão, administramos grupos de recursos de funcionários (ERGs) para fornecer um espaço seguro para os funcionários se conectarem e apoiarem uns aos outros. Nossos ERGs interempresariais incluem Veterans, Pride Network, Black Employee Network, Network e Neurodiversity.

Em toda a nossa empresa, reconhecemos a excelência, culminando nos Smiths Excellence Awards, a nossa celebração anual das atividades, pessoas e projetos mais extraordinários que melhor mostram os nossos pontos fortes e ajudam a impulsionar o nosso negócio. Anunciamos isso em nosso Smiths Day anual, uma celebração global dos Smiths em nossa rede.

description:
Join to apply for the Azure Machine Learning Engineer role at Netrix Global .

Netrix Global is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer within the Professional Services – Data Intelligence department. The role involves researching, building, designing, and maintaining artificial intelligence systems responsible for machine learning. The engineer will also serve as a key communicator between data science team members, working with data scientists and operational teams.

About The Opportunity

The Machine Learning Engineer will be a vital part of the data science team, focusing on AI systems development and improvement.

About The Team

  • Remote work environment
  • Opportunities for skill expansion and cross-functional knowledge

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Design, build, and optimize data workflows for Machine Learning and GenAI solutions in cloud environments.

  • Prepare data for AI and GenAI solutions.
  • Ensure integration of AI solutions within cloud architectures, including security and governance.

  • Monitor and improve model performance in production.

  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML Studio, and other Azure data tools.
  • Experience deploying Generative AI models.
  • Proficiency with DevOps tools and infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Ability to work in Agile/Scrum teams.

Location

Argentina (any part of the country is suitable)

Shift

9 a.m to 6 p.m, Monday to Friday

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits including Swiss Medical coverage
  • AWS certifications
  • Discounts, connectivity, competitive salary, remote work, and a supportive learning environment

About Us

Netrix Global values outcomes, teamwork, impact, enjoyment, and respect. We are committed to providing scalable, secure, data-driven solutions to complex business challenges.

What You Can Expect From Us

Competitive compensation, benefits, flexibility, casual environment, remote work options, and inclusive hiring practices. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.

title: Coordenador de Tesouraria
description:
Coordenador de Tesouraria para integrar nossa equipe de Finanças Corporativas. Será responsável por garantir que a equipe cumpra, com ética, responsabilidade e transparência, todos os procedimentos, políticas e processos financeiros da empresa, suas coligadas e controladas. Orientar-se por resultados, buscando constantemente simplificar e digitalizar atividades. Garantir a acuracidade dos dados e a integração de informações com áreas fornecedoras e clientes, zelando pela qualidade e pontualidade dos reportes sob sua responsabilidade. Liderar projetos que impactem a gestão de caixa e a execução das estratégias financeiras da alta direção.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Construir, acompanhar e atualizar o fluxo de caixa diário e direto das empresas geridas (previsto x realizado);
  2. Construir, acompanhar e atualizar o indicador de dívida e investimentos (previsto x realizado);
  3. Responder pela criação, manutenção e divulgação de indicadores de performance;
  4. Responder pela criação, manutenção e divulgação de reportes de Tesouraria (locais e internacionais);
  5. Liderar projetos sob responsabilidade da área;
  6. Suportar a alta gestão com estudos e avaliações financeiras;
  7. Acompanhar/cobrar a execução das SLAs financeiras com o CSM (prazo mínimo de pagamento, conciliação de contas, previsão de entradas, zeragem de contas, confirmação de lançamentos, entre outros);
  8. Negociar operações de câmbio e derivativos – hedge;
  9. Gerir e formar a equipe;
  10. Apoiar o superior na definição, negociação e formalização de operações financeiras;
  11. Elaborar, acompanhar e executar os KPIs definidos para a área a cada período.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou Engenharia;
  • Pós-graduação desejável;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em departamentos financeiros de grandes empresas (indústria, comércio ou varejo);
  • Sólida experiência em gestão de equipes;
  • Pacote Office avançado (ênfase em Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Desejável conhecimento em PowerBI;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em Matemática financeira, operações financeiras (passivas e ativas), fluxos operacionais financeiros;
  • Habilidades de comunicação, negociação, resiliência, gestão de tempo e relacionamento interpessoal.

Informações adicionais

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Convênio médico;
  • Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Wellhub;
  • Remuneração variável;
  • Plataforma de e-learning.

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.
The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.
Location: This is a Globally remote role
What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.
Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
What we offer you
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.
  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Join to apply for the L20130 Regional Corporate Counsel role at Epson do Brasil

Join to apply for the L20130 Regional Corporate Counsel role at Epson do Brasil

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Regional Corporate Counsel
A Regional Corporate Counsel specializing in corporate transactional work to provide expert legal advice and support for Epson's Industrial line of business, including strategic initiatives. This role involves drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements, managing transactions, and advising on compliance and government regulations. This position will require building relationships with senior management to create appropriate legal strategies to advance the Epson’s business goals in the Latin American region.
Key Responsibilities
Transactional Support:

  • Provide legal counsel on all aspects of corporate transactions, including strategic business deals and government sales.
  • Drafting, reviewing and negotiating a wide range of contracts and agreements, including customer sales agreements, distribution agreements, product lease agreements, loyalty program terms and conditions, master service agreements, NDAs, licensing agreements, policies and guidelines, release and consent forms.

title: Co-founder técnico - Novas Teses Talentum
description:
️ Essa vaga é para as novas teses da Talentum. Focada em empresas que estão em fase de pré-criação e que serão lançadas em breve. Se você sonha em construir uma empresa B2B e SaaS do zero, queremos conversar com você!
Procuramos pessoas que tenham o potencial e o desejo de se tornarem um Cofundador(a) técnico hands-on em uma startup nascente. Reconhecemos que a experiência e o conhecimento para essa construção pode vir de diversas fontes, pois não há uma trajetória única por trás de jornadas bem-sucedidas de empreendedorismo.
️Abaixo, estão alguns dos caminhos que, se você viveu, indicam uma chance mais alta de alinhamento ao que buscamos, cada um com seu diferente nível de experiência e potencial.

  • Experiência empreendedora prévia: ter (co)fundado uma empresa real, que independente do seu sucesso, conseguiu construir um produto, gerar algumas vendas e reter clientes.
  • Experiência em startups de alto crescimento: ter feito parte do time fundador e/ou time inicial de uma startup que viveu uma jornada de alto crescimento, entre as fases mercadologicamente marcadas como "Pré-seed" a "Series B".
  • ️ Experiência em Big Techs: ter trabalhado em funções de alto impacto (técnicas ou gerenciais) em empresas de tecnologia de ponta.
  • Experiência em consultorias: ter trabalhado pelo menos 2 anos em uma empresa de consultoria de referência.
  • Experiência como liderança: ter liderado pessoas em algum nível (colaboradores individuais ou líderes) durante a jornada.
  • Início de carreira com disposição ao generalismo: pessoas com alto potencial e intensa motivação, com visão sistêmica, mas sem conexões com capital.
️Essa não é uma lista exaustiva de requisitos. Nossa principal busca é por pessoas com intensa motivação e dispostas a viver a jornada empreendedora, com todos os sacrifícios que ela envolve.
️ Procuramos pessoas para empreender, e não colaboradores individuais — portanto, é preciso ter disposição para viver os altos e baixos da jornada early stage, e, independente da função executiva, fazer o que for preciso para a empresa prosperar, desde papéis estratégicos até os operacionais.
Os Diferenciais Da Talentum
A Talentum atua como um Co-fundador ativo e mão-na-massa, além de ser o primeiro investidor. Trazemos vantagens competitivas únicas, que empresas nascidas sozinhas não têm:
  • Contamos com um time qualificado e multidisciplinar para construir junto com você. Atuamos lado a lado desde o início, com especialistas em tecnologia, jurídico, backoffice, financeiro, relacionamento com investidores e vendas. Oferecemos suporte estratégico e operacional para acelerar o desenvolvimento do negócio de forma sólida e conectada com o mercado.
  • Temos playbooks que detalham cada passo da operação de uma empresa nascente.
  • Acessamos uma rede de mentores experientes: sempre que desafios complexos surgem, temos à nossa disposição uma rede de mentores experientes da indústria para auxiliar na discussão, guiando os empreendedores para a solução do problema.
  • Somos os primeiros investidores da empresa: com nossa injeção de caixa, suportamos a operação da empresa durante os momentos iniciais, para que os fundadores possam buscar as primeiras fontes de receita enquanto constroem seus mínimos produtos viáveis e suas operações.
  • Boilerplate de tecnologia: você contará com um boilerplate + design system robusto disponibilizado pela Talentum, para acelerar o desenvolvimento dos produtos.
Em Caso De Dúvidas, Contate-nos Pelo Linkedin

Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
Toll Facility Market Lead
As part of HDR’s Highways and Roads market sector, the toll facility market lead will be responsible to support our local areas with the identification and development of projects and programs where HDR can bring our suite of professional services to toll facility clients. Toll facility clients include agencies and authorities that own, operate and maintain roads, bridges and tunnels that charge fees to users that travel on their facilities.
Toll facilities will be a sub-sector to HDR’s highways and roads market sector within the transportation business group. Services that the toll facility market lead will look to bring to these clients include:

  • Planning and Design services including, roadway, bridges, tunnels, transport hydraulics and geotechnical
  • Mobility and operational technology services including ATST, ITS, CAV, tolling system development and operations, managed lanes, ZEM and OT cybersecurity
  • Advisory services including asset management, ROW, value engineering, funding and finance
  • Building and facility design
The toll facility market lead will be responsible for the growth and success of tolling services and programs for toll road clients and will be expected to work with area business development leaders and business group managers to:
  • Develop and share knowledge of trends and drivers within the toll market
  • Support areas in the identification, pursuit and delivery of area toll facility client opportunities where HDR can compete and deliver professional services
  • Support areas in the research of toll facility clients in their markets and help develop client relationships that include local area teams and market sector teams
  • Support TBG region directors in the evaluation and prioritization of toll facility client investments and opportunities across their regions and the business group as the program expands
The toll facility market lead will be an individual with established relationships with toll facility agencies and authorities and someone with a reputation of leading programs in the highway/roads market.
This role will be expected to work with HDR leaders across the business group to broaden the range of toll services offered by HDR and to provide professional development for staff as they provide services to toll facility clients.
The toll facility market lead will be expected to support local area and business group leaders in the identification and participation of industry organizations that will contribute to the growth of HDR with toll facility clients and within the highway and roads market sector.
The toll facility market lead will lead HDR’s strategy for presence and leadership in industry organizations including IBTTA and others.

HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
