description:
Join to apply for the SR UX designer role at dLocal

Join to apply for the SR UX designer role at dLocal

Why should you join dLocal?
dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.
By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.
What’s the opportunity?
We are looking for an experienced hands-on Senior UX Designer to join the Product team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the execution and the strategy of our main products, you’ll have a special focus on the transactional products and top merchant’s conversion rates, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to articulate business needs and user needs into thorough user experiences.
What will I be doing?

  • Lead the UX design process throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring that the solutions support the company’s overall strategy and goals
  • Communicate with different stakeholders to gather and prioritize product and customer requirements
  • Collaborate with global teams across engineering and product management to deliver scalable, user-friendly solutions
  • Develop wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to illustrate design concepts and interactions
  • Create user journey maps, and other UX artifacts to inform the design process
  • Conduct and evaluate quantitative and qualitative user research, to gather insights and validate design decisions
  • Work closely with developers to ensure feasibility and assist in the implementation of UI elements
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles throughout the product development lifecycle
  • Evaluate and measure the business impact of design and product solutions

What skills do I need?
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field (or equivalent and demonstrable work experience)
  • +5 years of experience working in digital products as a UX Designer or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing diverse projects
  • Solid understanding of user-centered design principles and product lifecycle
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable and scalable insights
  • Experience with user research methodologies and usability testing techniques
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision
  • Familiarity with product management tasks

Nice to have:
  • Experience leading teams and defining product strategies.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority
  • Knowledge and understanding of the payments industry and emerging markets context
  • Proficiency in utilizing metric tools, analyzing performance, and optimizing conversion funnels

What do we offer?
Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:
  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!*
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes
  • Social budget: you'll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!
  • For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

What happens after you apply?
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!
Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal!

title: Account Manager - Pleno | V4 Kloh Cerino & Co.
description:
Na V4 Company, não jogamos para perder. Estamos sempre à frente, conectando estratégia e performance para garantir crescimento previsível aos nossos clientes. Nosso time de Accounts é peça-chave nesse processo.
Se você busca desafios e quer crescer em um ambiente acelerado, essa oportunidade é para você!
Nosso jeito de trabalhar:

  • Transparência e atitude definem nossa rotina.
  • Colaboração é essencial – confiamos uns nos outros para alcançar resultados.
  • Nada de hierarquias engessadas: aqui você tem autonomia para decidir e agir.
Se faz sentido para você, vem crescer com a gente!
Como Account Manager Pleno , sua missão será gerenciar de forma autônoma projetos e contas de média complexidade, assegurando uma experiência excepcional (Customer Care) e identificando oportunidades de expansão e monetização dos contratos. Você será responsável por gerenciar recursos, prazos, escopos e orçamentos, garantindo a entrega de resultados e a satisfação dos clientes.
Principais responsabilidades:
  • Negociar estratégias de retenção e expansão.
  • Conduzir reuniões estratégicas e propor otimizações alinhadas ao negócio do cliente.
  • Analisar e interpretar métricas financeiras e de performance.
  • Mapear oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell.
  • Identificar sinais de churn e sugerir ações preventivas.
  • Propor e executar melhorias estratégicas baseadas em benchmarking e análise de concorrência.
Requisitos:
  • Conhecimento intermediário em gestão de escopo, orçamento e dashboards.
  • Capacidade de gerir conflitos e crises com autonomia.
  • Habilidade para orientar equipes comerciais em técnicas de negociação.
  • Entendimento sólido de métricas comerciais e funil de vendas.
  • Planejamento estratégico com definição de metas e KPIs.
  • Noções intermediárias de SPIN Selling.
  • Estratégia de retenção baseada em análise preditiva de métricas (LTV, Health Score).
O que oferecemos:
  • Os benefícios serão informados pela recrutadora.
  • Acesso aos cursos da Staage.
  • Onhappy - benefício corporativo de viagens a lazer.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo e aprendizado constante.
  • Gestão meritocrática.
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.
